    StartersBilly's red spiral pinwheelsPuff pastry rolled with sundried tomato pesto and parmesan, sliced into red spirals and baked crispHow to make it2 sheets of frozen puff pastry, thawed120g sundried tomato pesto40g parmesan, finely grated1 tsp dried oregano1 egg, beatenHeat the oven to 200°C and line two trays.Spread the pesto over the pastry sheets and scatter with the parmesan and oregano.Roll each sheet up tightly and chill until firm.Slice into 1.5cm rounds, lay flat on the trays and brush with egg.Bake until puffed and golden.Cool for a few minutes before serving.Matthews' stakeout jalapeño poppersJalapeño halves filled with cream cheese, cheddar and spring onion under a crunchy crumb, with sour creamHow to make it12 large jalapeños, halved and seeded200g cream cheese, soft80g cheddar, grated2 spring onions, finely sliced1/2 tsp smoked paprika50g panko breadcrumbs1 tbsp olive oil150g sour creamHeat the oven to 200°C and line a tray.Halve and seed the jalapeños, wearing gloves.Mix the cream cheese, cheddar, spring onion and paprika and fill the jalapeño halves.Toss the panko with the oil and press on top.Bake until the chillies blister and the crumb is golden.Serve hot with the sour cream.Cinnamon sugar doughnut holesKerry's pick.
